title: Doctor: what `expectrail doctor --json` found on one machine
description: Written by expectrail.doctor.document and read by expectrail.doctor.problems. It says what a verification needs on this machine and whether each piece is there. It is not a verdict on any change. No value of any key or other secret is in it: the required vision key check reports presence or absence without its value, and the required spend cap check reports its amount.

expectrail.description: The version of Expectrail that ran the checks.

ok.description: True exactly when no check that is required has a status other than ok. A reader recomputes it from the checks.

status.description: ok or missing for a piece that was checked; skipped when it could not be tried. A skipped check with required false and fix null does not apply on this system; it is not an ok check. Other skipped checks name what to fix before trying them. present or absent for the vision key.

required.description: A required piece that is not ok makes `ok` false and the command exit 3.

found.description: What was found, or what is wrong.

fix.description: What to do about it. Null for ok, present or absent, and for an optional skipped check that does not apply. Missing checks (even optional ones) and required skipped checks must name a non-empty fix. An applicable optional skipped check can also name a fix.
